target_customer: B2B SaaS, AI and fintech companies with complex or usage-based pricing, from growth-stage startups to enterprises
problem: Companies run pricing, quotes, invoicing and collections across spreadsheets and disconnected tools, causing slow approvals, billing errors and missed revenue.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for quote-to-cash and billing, with a free starter tier

founders.name: Aleks Đekić
founders.background_notes: Built a revenue platform for a 600-person go-to-market team at Dojo per the YC page.

founders.name: Jamie MacLeod
founders.background_notes: Helped grow Primer engineering from 30 to 100 per the YC page.

competitors.name: Orb
competitors.what: Usage-based and subscription billing and pricing platform for B2B companies

technical_complexity.rationale: Billing, metering and revenue recognition require accuracy and many integrations, but follow known patterns; usage-based pricing and quote workflows added moderate complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Billing systems are hard to replace once embedded, but the market holds strong rivals (Stripe Billing, Chargebee, Orb, Metronome) and a startup team in 2023 was small.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents and funded startups stayed active; Alguna positions itself as a single-vendor alternative to Stripe Billing, Chargebee, Maxio, Zuora, Orb and Metronome.

market_need_then: Usage-based pricing was spreading across SaaS and AI in 2023, as shown by Orb's $19.1M raise in March 2023 for pricing and billing.

branding.domain_note: Company uses alguna.com and the blog is on alguna.io.

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive but meaningless name with no found press or community about the brand itself; the name search returned only unrelated results.

outcome_analysis: Alguna went from YC S23 to a $4M seed announced October 2025, led by Mango Capital and Atlantic Labs, a slow two years between YC and its first confirmed round. It lists named customers such as Evervault and ComplyAdvantage and has added AI collections and an MCP server. The founders came from payments companies Dojo and Primer. Competition is intense, so the outcome is still open.
notes: The seed is confirmed by the company press release (via AccessNewswire) with Pulse 2.0 coverage; Preqin and CB Insights date it Sep 25, 2025. Investor lists vary: Salestools says Y Combinator led with Sequoia Scout Fund and SV Angel and a $28M valuation (unverified, contradicts the release); Preqin says YC participated. A $500K pre-seed in Sep 2023 appears only on Extruct and is unverified; CB Insights total of $4.5M across four rounds suggests other small rounds. Founders' education not given on the YC page. Founding year 2023 per YC and CB Insights; one profile says 2024. HQ conflicts (London per YC and Welcome to the Jungle, San Francisco on some aggregators).
